_about: Block-by-block layer tables for the four NeroEvents wreck variants. Convert each to data/neroevents/structures/wreck_<name>.nbt (structure block format) or place directly. Layers are listed bottom to top; each layer is a list of rows from north (first row) to south, each row a string of west->east cells. 'y' is the layer height relative to the ground plane: y 0 is the first block above the ground, y -1 replaces exactly one block of the ground surface (only the half-buried crate uses it). Every cell not in the key is structure void: the ground is never replaced below the plane. Facing letters follow the key; every placement goes through the protection query before any block is set.

wreck_pod_shell.description: A split landing-pod half-shell: a 2-high curved wall of hull plating on the north/east side, scorched panels on the ground side, one salvage crate inside, one bent strut leaning out.

wreck_strut_field.description: A flat scatter: five bent struts at mixed rotations, three scorched panels, the crate half-buried one block below the ground plane.

wreck_cargo_spill.description: A 3x3 plating floor with two salvage crates and a short 2-high plating wall on the north side; the rich variant, both crates roll loot.

wreck_hull_rib.description: A five-block arch of bent struts over a single crate, scorched panels at the arch feet; the tallest variant and the most recognisable from a distance.
